description: This Java source file defines the PdfSurveyServices class, which provides methods for creating, reading, and manipulating PDF-based surveys and responses within the OFBiz framework. It includes functionalities for extracting form fields, building surveys from PDFs, generating PDFs from survey responses, and updating form fields based on responses.

classes.name: PdfSurveyServices
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for handling PDF-based surveys and responses within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: buildSurveyFromPdf
methods.description: Creates a survey in the system based on the form fields extracted from a PDF file.

methods.name: buildSurveyResponseFromPdf
methods.description: Stores survey responses extracted from a filled PDF form into the system.

methods.name: getAcroFieldsFromPdf
methods.description: Extracts form field names and values from a PDF file.

methods.name: setAcroFields
methods.description: Populates form fields in a PDF with provided values.

methods.name: buildPdfFromSurveyResponse
methods.description: Generates a PDF document representing a survey response.

methods.name: buildSurveyQuestionsAndAnswers
methods.description: Retrieves questions and answers for a survey response, pairing each question with its answer.

methods.name: setAcroFieldsFromSurveyResponse
methods.description: Fills a PDF form with answers from a survey response and optionally saves the modified PDF.

methods.name: getInputByteBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the input PDF as a ByteBuffer, either from a file or from content stored in the system.
